title: Far-Right March in Jerusalem Demands Reestablishment of Gaza Settlements
detail: Israeli ministers and thousands of far-right lawmakers and settlers marched in Jerusalem demanding the reestablishment of illegal settlements in Gaza. The march, which drew broad cross-party political backing, signals growing pressure within the Israeli political establishment to resume settler colonization of Gaza following the conflict.

title: 1,143 Israeli Settlers Storm Al-Aqsa Compound; Palestinian Authority Condemns Provocation
detail: 1,143 Israeli settlers entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in Jerusalem, one of the largest single-day incursions recorded at the holy site. The Palestinian Authority condemned the storming as a deliberate provocation and violation of the holy site's sanctity.
